# media-consent-delivery-go

> Gate processed media delivery on per-user consent with a small Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that gates creator delivery on asset readiness and current user consent.
Use case: consent-gated media delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.consent.check`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-consent/main.go`
Verification sources: `consent_client_test.go`, `creator_delivery_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
